title: EnergyDataPoint
description: A generalized energy data point — the single shape used to carry any quantitative observation in the energy and utilities domain. Covers retail meter intervals, wholesale-market LMP prints, EIA time-series observations, NREL solar irradiance samples, weather-driven load drivers, EV-charging session telemetry, and DERMS device telemetry. Where a MeterReading captures a specific physical meter's measurement, an EnergyDataPoint is the broader observation envelope used across providers.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp marking the start of the observation interval (ISO 8601).

intervalSeconds.description: Length of the observation interval in seconds. 0 indicates an instantaneous reading. Common values: 60, 300, 900, 3600, 86400.

value.description: Numeric value of the observation, expressed in the units given by unit.

unit.description: Unit of measure for value. Includes energy, power, price, irradiance, temperature, and volumetric units commonly emitted by APIs in this catalog.

kind.description: What kind of measurement this is, independent of the unit. Helps consumers route a value through the right model.

location.description: Spatial reference for the data point.

marketNode.description: ISO/RTO pricing node, hub, or zone (e.g., CAISO SP15, ERCOT HB_HOUSTON, PJM WESTERN HUB).

balancingAuthority.description: NERC balancing authority code (e.g., CISO, ERCO, PJM, MISO, ISNE, NYIS, BPAT).

serviceTerritory.description: Utility service territory or DSO operating area.

asset.description: Physical or logical asset the observation belongs to (meter, charger, inverter, generator, sensor).

source.description: Provenance of the observation — which API delivered it.

providerId.description: Provider key from this catalog (e.g., eia, caiso, ercot, pjm, nrel, utilityapi, bayou, arcadia, nws, openweather, openadr, ocpi).

endpoint.description: Specific endpoint or report identifier the data came from.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering and rollup.

metadata.description: Provider-specific extensions that do not map into the core envelope.
